segments.name: Swoop® system
segments.description: Produces, supplies, services and commercializes a portable AI-powered ultra-low-field MR brain imaging system for hospitals, clinics and physician offices.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in one business segment, which includes all activities related to production, supply, service and commercialization of the Swoop® system.

revenueModel.text: Hospitals, critical care units, office-based neurology practices and third-party distributors pay for Swoop® system scanners and Optive AI software.
revenueModel.evidence: Our initial commercial focus has been in the U.S. market and with customers that use the Swoop® system inside the hospital setting primarily in critical care for pediatric and adult applications.
